profile.name: Sensirion EK-H4 温湿度传感器多路复用盒
profile.name_en: Sensirion EK-H4 humidity and temperature sensor multiplexer box
profile.description: 用于通过串口连接并读取最多 4 路 Sensirion 温湿度传感器的多路复用采集盒。在实验中可用于环境温度、相对湿度和露点的多通道监测。
profile.description_en: A multiplexer box that connects over a serial port and reads up to four Sensirion humidity and temperature sensor channels. It is used in laboratory setups for multi-channel monitoring of temperature, relative humidity, and dew point.

registry.name: Sensirion AG sensirion EKH4
